org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model

Class TelescopeConstants

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model.TelescopeConstants

  • public class TelescopeConstants
extends Object
    Constants data class containing telescope constants. This class is populated from database data in the Constant class and is made available to executors and the user interface controllers in the ConstantsCache.
